purpose: Test whether the native cold-v4 median shift persists across four additional disjoint 10-degree fields; no model or interval refit
selection: same quality-qualified strict Gaia cold dwarfs as cold_v4; fixed grz_clean plus WISE S/N >= 20 route, C to B to A with original color box and support
primary_metric: median and NMAD of final distance-modulus residual, predicted minus corrected-Gaia reference, with sky-block uncertainty
secondary_metrics: route acceptance, tier fractions, color and extinction strata, Gaia parallax and BP-RP distributions, DESI type boundary where matched
field_choice_basis: disjoint sky areas spanning Galactic longitudes about 15-230 degrees and latitudes about -77 to +40 degrees; DR11 south sweep filename existence only, no source rows inspected
